observations: Photo 0 shows a used automatic transmission with a 12V battery cable attached.
The transmission is surrounded by other car parts in a workshop or scrap yard environment.
The input shaft and output shaft flanges are visible.
The input shaft flange has a stamped 'X15' marking.
The output shaft flange has a stamped 'X15' marking.
The transmission casing shows significant surface dirt and grime.
No brand name, model number, or engine capacity sticker is legible in the photos.

claims.evidence: The photos show a used transmission but do not show a label or sticker confirming the brand.
No Ford Fusion badge or model-specific identification is visible on the transmission casing.
The photos do not show the engine to which this transmission is attached.
No engine capacity sticker is visible in the photos.

risks.risk: The transmission may be seized or have internal mechanical failure.
risks.proof: A video of the transmission being operated through all gears.

risks.risk: The transmission may be incompatible with the seller's Ford Fusion.
risks.proof: A photo of the engine block or a compatibility sticker.

risks.risk: The transmission may be missing internal components like the input shaft or output shaft.
risks.proof: A photo of the input and output shafts.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine block to confirm compatibility.
Video of the transmission being operated through all gears.
Photo of the input and output shafts.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
